- Initial release of the Insurance Agent — Sales Compliance Checklist skill.
- Provides a comprehensive compliance checklist for insurance agents and agencies covering licensing, suitability, replacement rules, disclosures, and E&O.
- Activates during sales, policy replacements, and producer onboarding; does not cover pure rating or coverage design.
- Includes detailed gate criteria, worked example, compliance anchors, and ready-to-use packs for agents/agencies.
- Features concise verification steps and red flags to help agents avoid common compliance pitfalls.
